Consequences handled explicitly: perspective makes the row pitch grow down every page and the amount column drift right, so both schedules carry PER-ROW hand-measured geometry (see the frames); rowbands' full-width scan finds only 9 of 16 rules on p2 and 7 of 16 on p3, recovered by the ADDENDUM N2 date-column `--col --text-lines` method; and the cover shows heavy SHOW-THROUGH of the Schedule A sheet behind it (donor city/ZIP fragments are legible through the paper). (1) OFFICE: the typed Office line reads **'Utah County Commisioner E'** — the filer's own misspelling of Commissioner, and a final letter that is unambiguously an **E** at 1400 dpi (three horizontal bars, not the two bowls of a B). index.csv carries 'County Commission Seat B'. Utah County's commission seats are A, B and C; there is no Seat E. THE SEAT IS THEREFORE NOT INFERRED and the channel's 'Seat B' is NOT corroborated by this page — recorded as a page-face/channel divergence for the coordinator (ADDENDUM N6: an Office box that does not corroborate the channel value). An intra-document date discrepancy of the ADDENDUM D6 class — both readings recorded, neither corrected. (3) AMENDMENT: **NEITHER the 'No' NOR the 'Yes' box is ticked** — the question is wholly unanswered, an honest BLANK, and is never read as 'No' (ADDENDUM J5). || REDACTION: three black bars, all on the cover (the address block, the phone field, and the signature line).
